observations: Photo 0 and 1 show a Nikon DSLR body with 'Nikon D3200' printed on the pentaprism, paired with a detached Nikon DX zoom lens marked '18-55' on its barrel.
Both items rest on a retail box printed 'Nikon D3200 18-55 VR II Kit, BLACK, AF-S DX NIKKOR 18-55mm f/3.5-5.6G VR II'.
Rear lens cap and body cap are on, so the mount and sensor are not visible in either photo.
No LCD screen, viewfinder, top-panel display, battery, charger, strap, or memory card are visible in either photo.
Watermarks 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'PHOTOPLUG INTEGRATED' are overlaid on both images.
No power-on, shutter-fire, or lens-zoom demonstration is shown; both photos are near-duplicate angles of the same static setup.

claims.evidence: Matches known D3200 spec but sensor is not visible in either photo; no way to confirm this unit's sensor from images.
No menu screen, settings display, or test shot shown in either photo.
Internal processor claim cannot be confirmed from exterior photos.
Rear screen is not visible/oriented toward camera in either photo.

risks.risk: Sensor could have dust, scratches, or fungus
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the sensor with lens removed, in good light
risks.if_unproven: priced as sensor condition unknown/worst case

risks.risk: Lens glass may have fungus, haze, or scratches; zoom/focus ring may be stiff
risks.proof: Macro photo through both lens ends with a light source, plus a clip of zoom/focus action
risks.if_unproven: priced as lens condition unknown/worst case

risks.risk: High shutter count reducing remaining lifespan
risks.proof: Screenshot of shutter count from a shutter-count checker or camera menu

risks.if_unproven: priced as body+lens only, no accessories assumed

proof_requests: Video of the camera powering on and firing the shutter
Photo of the rear screen turned on
Close-up of the sensor with lens detached
Close-up through both ends of the lens with a light behind it, plus a zoom/focus action clip
Photo of the body's serial number matched against the box's serial sticker
Photo showing all included accessories (battery, charger, strap, caps, card)
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a Nikon D3200 with 18-55mm VR II kit lens from the body and box markings, but no functional, screen, sensor, or shutter-count proof is shown, so it must be priced at worst case pending that proof.
